name: d-stack
description: Skills for sharper questions, primary-source research, learning, clear writing, and delegated tool work.

interface.longDescription: Thirteen Markdown workflows for primary-source research, learning, questioning plans, finding reading material, writing clear prose, and operating Claude Code and Codex as services. For Claude Code and Codex users. Operator requires an authenticated coding-agent CLI and the tools its task needs. Some skills require interactive question tools; grill-with-docs also requires the upstream domain-modeling skill. No MCP server or account connection is bundled.
